agent.problem: The blank asks for the unseen wording of the prophetic line. Earlier cards do not give the baker a way to reason out "sword" rather than "wind" or "plague," so this is a wording guess rather than a test of meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The blank asks for the next word of a line the baker has not seen. Being told that Moab will be captured does not establish whether Chemosh goes into exile, battle or hiding, so the baker is left guessing.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: "In that hard line" and "who else" depend on story card 15, which is no longer on screen. The question needs to restate the first curse so that it stands on its own.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: Discovery questions dominate the stop. Cards 2, 4, 9, 11 and 13, along with the fill-in-the-blank problems on cards 6 and 12, ask for unrevealed details that cannot be reasoned out from the earlier cards. This goes beyond the allowed few discovery questions.

rule.text:
Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

agent.problem: Story cards 3 and 5 each have three sentences. Card 10 also has three narrator sentences even when its whole quotation is treated as one unit. Only the opening story card may run to three sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
